Kelmarsh: \(3,268 \div 11 = 296.(?)\) pupils per school.  
Redfen: \(3,147 \div 10 = 314.7\) pupils per school.  

Difference: \(314.7 - 296.3636\ldots = 18.3363\ldots\), which rounds to 18.34 pupils per school.

ANSWER: Redfen | 18.34

ANSWER: Redfen | 17.97
